roadmap.scope: Slice 1 (phase 01): the pure claim_domain::authority person rules plus a CLI gate entry from local checks (U-OOS-3), gating claim add and the shared sign batch for github:<login> subjects; dispute and withdrawal stay open. Slice 2 (phase 02): v8 repo_authority_checks, read_repo_authority with its recorded-fixture contract test (U-OOS-8), authority verify, then every signature through sign_permitted with repo subjects gated in claim add, scrape --sign and claim publish. Slice 3 (phase 03): score_attested, labels, --include-unattested, viewer and search. Slice 4 (phase 04): the review-app share draft only (SA-1). Slice 5 (phase 05): imported candidates kept locally and listed offline.

conventions.paradigm: ADR-007 functional Rust. kind, requirement, classify, the CLI gate entry, the hand-off data, the refusal tally, labels and score_attested are pure (claim-domain, scoring, scraper-domain, viewer-domain, review-domain). Verbs, the viewer and adapters do I/O only. ADTs over flags (Kind, Requirement, Authority, Unattested reason, PermitBasis, SigningRefusal). Crafter: nw-functional-software-crafter.
conventions.test_paradigm: Acceptance: example-based subprocess runs of the REAL openlore binary over the real DuckDB store, fakes only for GitHub, PDSes and the network index (DISTILL walking-skeleton strategy). Pure core: proptest (256 cases) against the CORE-OOS oracles plus crafter-owned proptests in claim-domain / scoring with state-delta (tests/common/state_delta.rs) over a declared universe; single-example unit tests only with a `// bypass:` reason. Adapters: real DuckDB and recorded GitHub fixtures, never mocked. CLI and HTTP scenarios stay single-example (wiring, not invariants).
conventions.scenario_fns: `<test target>::<fn>`. CLI targets (crates/cli): owner_only_signing (slice 1), owner_only_signing_repos (slices 2 and 5), owner_only_signing_readers (slice 3), owner_only_signing_core (CORE-OOS properties). Review app target (crates/openlore-review-app): owner_only_signing_review_app (SA-1). Each step lists every fn it activates, RED driver first. Every #[ignore] fn of the five targets maps to exactly one step; the ACTIVE guards PS-3, PS-7 and IC-5 are named in the step whose code they protect. regenerate_the_frozen_v7_store_fixture is a fixture regenerator, not a step, and stays ignored (it refuses once v8 exists).
conventions.rider_classes: Each step names one RED driver. Other activations are a secondary driver (new behaviour, RED on activation: un-ignore, see it RED, make it green within the step) or a guard (expected green on activation or already active: record a mutation RED per mutation_red_on_pass).
conventions.core_binding_red: A step binding a CORE-OOS property first lands the production function as a signature stub with a todo!() body, then points the sut_* binding at it, so un-ignoring gives a panic RED, never a compile error (DWD-OOS-10). A property may move unchanged in name and assertions into crates/claim-domain/tests or crates/scoring/tests.
conventions.test_edit_allow_list: (1) Removing the #[ignore] of a named scenario fn. (2) Replacing a named sut_* todo!() body in owner_only_signing_core.rs with ONE real call plus view mapping. (3) U-OOS-12: one added row in PS-2 (or PS-5, see 01-03) and one in RA-4, built only from existing support/authority.rs vocabulary. (4) Wording pins in support/authority.rs, one-line edits only (DWD-OOS-3). (5) Shipped-suite migration per conventions.shipped_suite_migration. (6) U-OOS-9 request-log exclusion in crates/test-support/src/fake_github_accounts.rs. Forbidden otherwise: assertions, oracles, strategies, universe slots, guardrails, test names of the owner_only_signing* targets. A missing vocabulary step stops the step and goes to nw-acceptance-designer. Crafter-owned tests in their own crates (adapter-duckdb, adapter-github contract tests, claim-domain, scoring, xtask synthetic violations) may be added.
conventions.shipped_suite_migration: DISTILL wave-decisions lists ~40 shipped acceptance files the behaviour change breaks. Each is migrated IN THE STEP THAT INTRODUCES THE BREAKING BEHAVIOUR, so every step ends with the whole cli and review-app suites green: person gate in claim add (01-01) and in the sign batch (01-05); repo gate in claim add incl. WS-1..WS-10, U-OOS-2 (02-04); repo gate in scrape --sign (02-05); claim publish gate (02-07); score_attested (03-01); search label, IR-16b (03-05); share draft (04-01). Allowed changes: a Given seeded with authority through support/authority.rs steps (e.g. the_repo_holds_authority_file + given_jeff_verified_authority_of), a non-github: subject where the test does not depend on the github: scheme, or the expectation changes DISTILL names (score expectations, IR-16b flip, CORE-6 sut re-point). Prefer migrating the shared seeding helper so callers stay untouched. Every changed file and changed expectation is listed in the commit message. A failure outside the step's expected set stops the step.
conventions.transitional_risk: T1 (needs orchestrator ruling, as RRA F3 was): during phase 01 only Required(Person) assertions are gated; Required(Repo) assertions keep today's ungated signing path because no repo observation store exists before 02-01. 02-04 closes T1: from then on every IdentityPort::sign goes through sign_permitted with a SigningPermit and repo subjects are gated. Recorded in 01-01 and 02-04 notes.
conventions.gate_order: The CLI gate entry (may_sign_from_checks, name the crafter's) is born thin in 01-01 and completed in 01-04 (window, RepoListed basis, GateRow total). ADR-089's may_sign keeps its signature and stays the only entry the review app calls. Permits are minted only inside claim_domain::authority. sign_permitted and publish_signed_claim(&SigningPermit) land in 02-04 and 02-07.
conventions.migrations: v8 = repo_authority_checks only, in 02-01 (forward-only, idempotent, insert-only, live probe). imported_candidates is v9 in 05-01: v8 may reach users' stores long before slice 5 and stores are forward-only, so it cannot be widened later (DESIGN and DISTILL wrote 'v8 imported_candidates'; RA-12/RA-12b guardrails count only v7 and v8, so v9 changes no test). Never regenerate the frozen v7 fixture after 02-01.
conventions.check_arch: `cargo xtask check-arch` + `cargo test -p xtask`; each new or amended rule ships a synthetic-violation test. authority_evidence_only_from_adapters extended to the CLI evidence types (01-03); repo_authority_checks_insert_only (02-01); authority_readers_hold_no_write_handle (02-02); sign_only_with_permit (02-04); scoring_callers_use_score_attested (03-01); INDEXER_FORBIDDEN_DEPS gains adapter-github (03-05); imported_candidates_not_in_scoring_or_inference (05-01).
conventions.test_runs: Feature targets: `cargo nextest run -p cli --test owner_only_signing --test owner_only_signing_repos --test owner_only_signing_readers --test owner_only_signing_core` and `cargo nextest run -p openlore-review-app --test owner_only_signing_review_app`. Whole suites: `cargo nextest run -p cli` and `cargo nextest run -p openlore-review-app`. Scoped crates only, never the workspace.
conventions.done_per_step: A step is done when its scenario fns are un-ignored and green, the active guards (PS-3, PS-7, IC-5) pass, the feature targets pass, and every shipped cli and review-app suite passes (whole-suite runs above), plus the crate and xtask commands in its green list.
conventions.mutation_red_on_pass: A guard green on activation gets a recorded mutation RED: break the named rule in production code, run the guard and show it fails, revert. Rule, failing scenario and revert go in the commit message and the execution log RED phase.
conventions.wording: Labels, refusal fragments, hand-off lines, footers and usage messages are DISTILL pins in tests/acceptance/support/authority.rs (DWD-OOS-3); DELIVER may change a pin only by a one-line edit there.
conventions.exit_codes: A refused signature exits non-zero; candidates are still listed (DWD-OOS-4). Usage mistakes exit 2 (RD-11).
conventions.forge_build_time: Forge 6 (DISTILL R6): 01-01 measures the acceptance build of the new targets once; if over the CI acceptance-stage budget, owner_only_signing_core.rs is consolidated into a claim-domain test target in 01-04 (core_binding_red allows the move).
conventions.upstream_ids: U-OOS-2 -> 02-04. U-OOS-3 -> 01-01 + 01-04. U-OOS-8 -> 02-02 (before any repo signing step). U-OOS-9 -> 02-05 and 04-01. U-OOS-10 -> 01-03. U-OOS-12 -> 01-03 (PS-2 row) and 02-02 (RA-4 --mine row).
